title: Catwalk for Causes: $450K+ Raised for Charlotte Charities
text:
NASCAR & NFL Stars Raise Over $450,000 at Catwalk for Causes, Honoring Sherry PollexS Legacy
A sold-out evening of fashion and philanthropy saw NASCAR and NFL stars walk the runway alongside children impacted by serious illnesses, raising over $450,000 for charity. The event, Catwalk for Causes, presented by Cook out, continued a tradition started in 2009 by Sherry Pollex and martin Truex Jr., benefiting Speedway Children’s Charities (SCC). The event was held at Ten Tenths Motor Club in Charlotte, North Carolina.
The funds raised will support SCC Charlotte’s mission to provide financial assistance to organizations that help children in need. The event was a collaborative effort, with support from several prominent organizations and individuals.
The event was held in collaboration with the Kyle Larson Foundation, Samantha & Kyle Busch’s Bundle of Joy Fund, and Greg Olsen’s HEARTest Yard. SCC’s Charlotte chapter hosted a fashion show alongside both silent and live auctions.
Among the celebrated guests were NASCAR drivers Joey Logano, John Hunter Nemechek, and Daniel hemric, alongside former Carolina Panthers Luke Kuechly and jonathan Stewart. The event wasn’t just about showcasing fashion; it was about celebrating the resilience and spirit of the children and families served by these organizations.
Voices from the Catwalk
Participants emphasized the importance of continuing Pollex’s work and bringing joy to children facing difficult circumstances. “Sherry Pollex put a lot of effort into this event and it is grate to be a part of keeping her legacy going and put a smile on these kids’ faces,” stated a leading driver. “Tonight’s the best part. We enjoy dressing up and getting to hang out with the families and the kids and really just let them be the stars tonight.”
Another NASCAR driver echoed this sentiment, noting the profound impact of the event.”There’s so much that these kids go through on a daily basis. To be able to see them smile and enjoy themselves for a night is super rewarding,” he said. “having two girls, I can’t imagine what some of the parents and the kids have to go through. So being able to bring a smile to their face and enjoy that moment with them, and raise money for a great cause… I’m super excited to be part of it.”
The event’s location also held meaning. According to Speedway Motorsports CEO and chairman, hosting Catwalk for Causes at Ten Tenths motor Club was a fitting tribute. “Being able to host Catwalk for Causes here…to celebrate Sherry Pollex and how she made such a great impact on children and the motorsports industry around her, it’s been really cool to be able to continue that legacy.”
For Samantha Busch, co-founder of the Bundle of Joy Fund, the evening was particularly poignant. “It’s always an amazing night for the kids,” she shared. “But tonight, it’s really special for us to get to have our Bundle of Joy Fund kids here. And we brought Brex because obviously he’s the inspiration that started all of it.”
Former NFL player Greg Olsen highlighted the collective effort of the participating foundations. “What an amazing venue to be up here with some unbelievable other foundations in the local area that do such great work,” he said. “Our family the HEARTest Yard – we’re just really excited to be a part of a fun night and a special night and help a lot of kids who really,really deserve it.”
Supporting SCC Charlotte: opportunities to Give
Fans can continue to support SCC Charlotte through several upcoming initiatives. A 50/50 raffle will be held this weekend at the NHRA Carolina 4-Wide Nationals, and the SCC Legacy Shop will be open during next month’s Bank of America ROVAL™ 400 NASCAR Playoffs weekend.
To learn more about Speedway Children’s Charities, upcoming events, or donation opportunities, visit www.speedwaycharities.org or follow them on social media via Facebook, Instagram, or X (formerly Twitter).
